actions.name: ransomware actors use significant financial events to target victims
actions.description: Ransomware actors are very likely using significant financial events, such as mergers and acquisitions, to target and leverage victim companies for ransomware infections.

actions.name: ransomware actors research publicly available and material nonpublic information prior to attack
actions.description: Prior to an attack, ransomware actors research publicly available information, such as a victim’s stock valuation, as well as material nonpublic information.

actions.name: ransomware actors threaten to disclose material nonpublic information if ransom not paid quickly
actions.description: If victims do not pay a ransom quickly, ransomware actors will threaten to disclose this information publicly, causing potential investor backlash.

actions.name: ransomware actors target companies involved in significant, time-sensitive financial events to incentivize ransom payment
actions.description: Ransomware actors are targeting companies involved in significant, time-sensitive financial events to incentivize ransom payment by these victims.

actions.name: ransomware initial intrusion via trojan malware allows access broker reconnaissance
actions.description: Ransomware is often a two-stage process beginning with an initial intrusion through a trojan malware, which allows an access broker to perform reconnaissance and determine how to best monetize the access.

actions.name: ransomware targets are carefully selected from initial trojan malware victims based on reconnaissance
actions.description: Most victims of trojans are not also victims of ransomware, indicating ransomware targets are often carefully selected from a pool based on information gleaned from the initial reconnaissance.

actions.name: cyber criminals identify non-publicly available information during reconnaissance to use as leverage
actions.description: During the initial reconnaissance phase, cyber criminals identify non-publicly available information, which they threaten to release or use as leverage during the extortion to entice victims to comply with ransom demands.

actions.name: impending events affecting stock value encourage ransomware actors to target or adjust extortion timeline
actions.description: Impending events that could affect a victim’s stock value, such as announcements, mergers, and acquisitions, encourage ransomware actors to target a network or adjust their timeline for extortion where access is established.

actions.name: ransomware actor 'Unknown' posted on Russian hacking forum Exploit about using NASDAQ to influence extortion
actions.description: In early 2020, a ransomware actor using the moniker “Unknown” made a post on the Russian hacking forum “Exploit” that encouraged using the NASDAQ stock exchange to influence the extortion process.

actions.name: ransomware actors threatened to leak victim data to NASDAQ to impact stock
actions.description: Unidentified ransomware actors negotiating a payment with a victim during a March 2020 ransomware event stated, “We have also noticed that you have stocks. If you will not engage us for negotiation we will leak your data to the nasdaq and we will see what's gonna (sic) happen with your stocks.”

actions.name: at least three publicly traded US companies involved in mergers and acquisitions were ransomware victims between March and July 2020
actions.description: Between March and July 2020, at least three publicly traded US companies actively involved in mergers and acquisitions were victims of ransomware during their respective negotiations.

actions.name: two of three pending mergers ransomware victims were under private negotiations
actions.description: Of the three pending mergers, two of the three were under private negotiations.

actions.name: Pyxie RAT searches victim network for keywords related to stock share price
actions.description: A November 2020 technical analysis of Pyxie RAT identified several keyword searches on a victim’s network indicating an interest in the victim’s current and near future stock share price, including 10-q1, 10-sb2, n-csr3, nasdaq, marketwired, and newswire.

actions.name: Darkside ransomware actors posted message showing interest in impacting victim share price
actions.description: In April 2021, Darkside ransomware actors posted a message on their blog site stating their interest in impacting a victim’s share price and threatening to provide information before publication to enable earning from share price reduction.
